text: Share Conversation as Image 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的对话图片插件。它在每条已完成的助手回复旁加入图片操作，并通过对话区域和全局浮层提供消息选择器及预览。用户可以选择要分享的消息，使用 Canvas 2D 将其绘制成 PNG 卡片，再下载图片或复制到剪贴板。渲染内容包括用户与助手消息，并处理代码块、列表和引用；过长内容会截断到近期消息。适合需要把 DSH 对话整理成可分享图片的用户。图片在浏览器本地生成，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

Share Conversation as Image adds a picture action to DSH Web replies. Select messages, render a PNG locally, then preview, download, or copy it. The card formats text, code, lists, and quotes; long chats are shortened to recent messages. No API key or external service is needed.
想把几条 DSH 对话消息做成一张 PNG 分享出去。
能不能挑选聊天里的部分问答，再导出成图片？
我想把助手的回答连同相关提问保存成可复制的图片。
Share Conversation as Image 的功能「选择消息并生成 PNG」：点击已完成助手回复旁的图片操作，选择对话消息后创建预览卡片；用户可从预览下载 PNG、复制图片，或返回调整选择。

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · Share Conversation as Image：A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns selected conversation messages into a PNG
card you can download or copy.

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · Share Conversation as Image：- Pick exactly which messages go into the image.
- One click on any assistant reply starts from that reply plus the question
  before it.
- Rendered locally with Canvas as a clean reading card: a compact brand
  header, right-aligned user bubbles, assistant answers with code blocks,
  lists, and quotes, plus a footer that repeats the brand rule and the capture
  details.
- Download as PNG or copy straight to the clipboard. Nothing leaves the
  browser.

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · Install：This package replaces `dsh-plugin-share-image`. The existing
`conversation-share-image` bundle row and action/overlay IDs stay unchanged.
Unload the former bundle before replacing dependency/module references; do not
load both names together. The former npm package is retained for migration.

Package name: `@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image`. There is no build step; the package
ships `client.js` as-is.

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · Install：**Ask your DSH agent** to install the bundle from `@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image`
(npm) or `github:ShoWin2333/dsh-share-image`; the plugin manager adds the
dependency and the profile's bundle list for you.

**Or install it manually** into a profile (profile name substituted):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image          # npm
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:ShoWin2333/dsh-share-image  # from source
```

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · Usage：Every finalized assistant reply has a picture action beside Copy and Branch.
Clicking it opens the message picker with that answer and the question before
it already checked.

In the picker, tick the messages to include — **Select all** picks the whole
conversation — then choose **Create image**. The preview offers **Download
PNG** and **Copy image**, plus **Back to selection** to change the set.

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · Usage：The card contains the selected messages: your messages sit in DeepSeek-blue
bubbles on the right, assistant answers run as plain text on the left, and a
header and footer carry the brand and the capture details. Reasoning, tool
calls, command rows, and system context are left out so the image reads like a
transcript rather than a log.

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · Notes and limits：- Only content already loaded in the current view can be selected. If older
  turns have not been paged in yet, the picker says so.
- Consecutive assistant steps are shown as one row in the picker and merged
  into one answer in the image; unselected messages in between are skipped.
- A very long conversation is truncated to fit one image; the card then ends
  with a note saying the most recent messages were kept.
- The card is laid out at phone width (390 logical px) and exported at up to
  3x, so it fills a phone screen with readable text wherever it is shared.
- The card keeps a fixed light palette, independent of the active UI theme.
- The PNG is generated locally in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · How it is put together：- `index.js` — Host half, intentionally empty; the bundle only mounts.
- `client.js` — the whole client plugin: Canvas renderer, picker, preview
  overlay, locale dictionaries, and slot registrations.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch that inserts the plugin row.
- `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` — message catalogs for the plugin store.

The plugin registers two slots:

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · How it is put together：- `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` — the picture action on each finalized
  assistant message.
- `shell.overlay` — the message picker and image preview modal.

No options. The bundle is entirely browser-side; the Host half exists only to
mount the bundle in the profile.

@showin2333/dsh-plugin-share-image README · Development：Clone the repository and point a profile at the checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-share-image
```

Add the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles`, then edit `client.js`. DSH hot-reloads
client plugins, so slot changes appear without restarting the profile; a
`node --check client.js` catches syntax errors.
